title: Pooka in the Accordance War
summary: How the pooka fought after the Night of Iron Knives.

claims.text: The pooka were enraged by the killings of the Night of Iron Knives: humans had hunted them before, but never had changelings killed with such cold planning, and the pooka banded together against their oppressors.
Those who could fight did so without mercy, while the small and weak scouted and spied; shifting into small animals such as mice, many slipped into enemy freeholds and became legends of the war.
